children: SES reported Q3 revenue growth of 4.2% and Adjusted EBITDA growth of 18.6% year over year, like-for-like. It reiterated FY26 revenue and Adjusted EBITDA guidance of stable year over year and lowered expected CapEx to around €600M from €700M.

Detail
AI Analyst View
FY26 CapEx now around €600M, from €700M
The €100M reduction lowers planned investment spending; the release does not quantify the effect on cash flow.
FY26 revenue and Adjusted EBITDA: stable YoY
Outlook was reiterated, not raised; the comparison is like-for-like and at constant FX.
Q3 revenue +4.2% and Adjusted EBITDA +18.6% YoY LFL
Growth was supported partly by Mobility contract restructuring, including a positive Q3 impact; it may not represent recurring growth.
YTD Adjusted Net Loss €82M; 2025 profit €72M
The earnings reversal reflects higher depreciation and financing costs, including costs associated with the Intelsat acquisition.
Adjusted Net Debt/EBITDA 3.7x; 3.9x at 2025 year-end
Leverage improved but remains above the company's stated target of 3.0x or below.
YTD backlog additions €5.8B; total backlog €10.0B
The contracted backlog provides visibility, though the release gives no prior-period comparison.
Context by AI Analyst

This is an early post-Intelsat-integration results update, with reported growth affected by consolidation and contract restructurings. Investors will look for Q4 results and FY26 delivery, particularly whether stable guidance and lower CapEx translate into improved earnings and leverage.
Based on the original press release from SES S.A. distributed by BusinessWire.
